tables.description: Daily transactional sales data for FMCG products including details about sku, brand, channel, and units sold.
Aggregated weekly data containing advanced metrics and target variables for predictive modeling.

columns.name: units_sold
columns.description: Number of units sold in that week

columns.name: promotion_flag
columns.description: Whether there was a promotion that week ('True'/'False' or '1'/'0'). NOTE: this is VARCHAR here but INTEGER on fmcg_sales.promotion_flag -- the certified promotional_uplift formula (promotion_flag = 1) is written for fmcg_sales and must not be applied to this column as-is.

columns.name: delivery_days
columns.description: Average delivery days in that week

columns.name: is_holiday_peak
columns.description: Whether it is a peak holiday week ('True'/'False')

columns.name: is_holiday_week
columns.description: Whether it is a holiday week ('True'/'False')

columns.name: is_summer
columns.description: Whether it is in the summer season ('True'/'False')

columns.name: is_winter
columns.description: Whether it is in the winter season ('True'/'False')

columns.name: sku_age
columns.description: How long the SKU has been active in weeks

columns.name: lifecycle_stage
columns.description: Product lifecycle stage (e.g., launch, mature, decline)

columns.name: lag_1
columns.description: Units sold in the previous week (lag 1)

columns.name: rolling_std_4
columns.description: 4-week rolling standard deviation of units sold

columns.name: target_next_week
columns.description: Target prediction variable for next week's units sold

business_metrics.definition: (SUM(CASE WHEN promotion_flag = 1 THEN units_sold ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN promotion_flag = 0 THEN units_sold ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN promotion_flag = 0 THEN units_sold ELSE 0 END), 0)
business_metrics.description: The percentage increase in units sold during promotional periods vs non-promotional periods.
The rate at which available stock is being sold.
